actions.share_report_email.description: Sends report in email body with optional attachments.
actions.share_report_email.props.attach_: Select which export formats to attach to the email
actions.share_report_email.props.include: Place the report HTML directly into the email body
Include Report HTML in Email Body
actions.share_report_email.props.message: Additional text content included in the email body
actions.share_report_email.props.report_: JSON object with report parameters like {"param_name": "value"}
actions.share_report_email.props.subject: Email subject line
Subject
actions.upload_csv.description: Uploads a CSV file and creates new or refreshes existing CSV cube.
actions.upload_csv.props.csvFile.descrip: The CSV file to upload. Can be plain CSV or compressed (.gz, .zip)
actions.upload_csv.props.cubeId.descript: Select an existing CSV cube to refresh, or leave empty to create a new cube
actions.upload_csv.props.filename.descri: Custom filename for the uploaded CSV. Include .gz or .zip extension if the file is compressed.
